import re
msgs=[]
for r in rows:
 m=r.get('message',{})
 if m.get('role')=='user':
  txt=''.join(c.get('text','') for c in m.get('content',[]) if isinstance(c,dict))
  if 'Demo pair' in txt: msgs.append(txt)
print(len(msgs), [len(x) for x in msgs])
def get_grids(txt):
 pairs=[]
 for m in re.finditer(r'Demo pair (\d+) input \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n(.*?)\nDemo pair \1 output \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n(.*?)(?=\n\nSame instance\.|\Z)',txt,re.S):
  idx,ih,iw,ins,oh,ow,outs=m.groups()
  parse=lambda s:[[int(v) for v in line.split()] for line in s.strip().splitlines()]
  a,b=parse(ins),parse(outs)
  assert len(a)==int(ih) and all(len(r)==int(iw) for r in a)
  assert len(b)==int(oh) and all(len(r)==int(ow) for r in b)
  pairs.append((a,b))
 return pairs
pairs=[p for t in msgs for p in get_grids(t)]
print(len(pairs),[(len(a),len(b)) for a,b in pairs])
